text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived. For the New Year's break, I figured I'd play
board games with Rulership in the Trainer's Room...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That was what I had intended to do, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying.
Air Groove-san's family home. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The school I grew up in.
It's their New Year's party.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Of course not!
I wanted to play board games with you too.
However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san's silent pressure is immense, you see.
Heh, like a moth flying into a flame—that's me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though the explanation was delivered calmly, it seemed it really was force majeure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So you've arrived, Ruler. And you as well, Trainer.
Be sure to give Mother a proper greeting.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —There you are.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove.
No... Alve.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're still a newcomer.
Let's just say I'll give you a proper welcome today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You'll... help me?
...You'd better not push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Why not?! I was here first, so it's totally natural, right???

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Allow me to make introductions. This Umamusume is Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: One thing led to another, and I've been overseeing her training lately. Sometimes I even have her help with student guidance at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know who this Umamusume is.
She's an incredible racer who achieved
consecutive victories in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why... but even though she's a newcomer,
she carries herself proudly, like a senior apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why does she always have to
take the psychological upper hand...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, that's enough chit-chat.
Today is an important New Year's party.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, write your New Year's resolutions
with traditional calligraphy.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Kakizome, is it?
Very well. I shall dash off a quick piece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, each took up their brush...
and all their resolutions were laid out.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Me?
For me, it's this—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Multi-Tiered Stance"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't rely on just one strategy; prepare a second and third move.
That is the true secret to victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's so like you, Ruler.
Well, it's not a bad idea, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Groove, what did you say?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll... take this one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Hard work."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Eff... ort...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: This is it...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Who writes a worn-out word like "effort" with a straight face these days?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And the trouble is, she actually sees it through to the end.
She writes out "effort" and puts in the effort,
winning against those who didn't.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Completely humorless and utterly hopeless, isn't it? It's as if Air Groove-san put on clothes and started walking around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I always wear clothes, though.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... that's true, but...
Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, what's with this, what is going on?!
My position is slowly getting worse and worrrssse...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Traaaiineer~, isn't there any way
to make this elf eat dirt!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't know if they'll be crying home to mama... but Rulership is the one who seems poised to win...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Board games... I knew you'd bring that up.
I might not have a chance on the track yet, but with board games, it's a different story.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Even so, winning with a hardcore, punishing setup wouldn't feel great. I'm not that heartless.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what kind would you like?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I think to myself. A game that anyone could play, to play together with Admire Groove...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Memory, huh?
A pure contest of recall ability...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That might be fair.
Alright, let's duel, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Hmph, it's an overwhelming victory so far... But,
they're holding on pretty stubbornly...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, let's test him a bit.
I discreetly moved one face-down card, but...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The other ace is... right there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Geh, she's watching closely!
This girl... is getting better and better...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... co-evolution, triggered by my influence?
Damn it, what a monster...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rulership had his brain running
at full throttle right from New Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after returning to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sugoroku, huh?
Well, it feels like it's almost entirely luck-based anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That might be more fitting for New Year's.
Alright, it's a match, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You ready?
Now then, how should I carve you up?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Fundamentally it comes down to the dice rolls, but there are a few ways to sabotage. If I use them effectively...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, sugoroku? Count me in too~♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Professor...? No, this isn't a game, it's a serious duel...
If it turns into a free-for-all, strategy goes right out the window...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't be cold to Mother, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Time to give it my all♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooh~, why does it have to be like this~~?
Just you watch~, I'm still gonna do it anyway~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be a serious showdown—
but thanks to an unexpected interloper, it somehow turned into a heartwarming moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after returning to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Werewolf, huh?
A psychological game where you figure out who the wolf is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That might actually be interesting.
All right, let's do this, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the game heated up—entering the final phase.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you're the wolf, aren't you?
Alv..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You can't fool my battle-tested eyes.
Come on, look me straight in the eye."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Look closely...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's... not a wolf.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Which one is it with this guy~~~???)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She shows no emotion, making her impossible to read...
Admire Groove was immensely strong, and in the end,
the match concluded in a dead heat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after returning to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Good grief, hard workers are utterly tedious creatures. But...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—I can't underestimate them at all.
When I look at Alv and Air Groove-san,
I feel like they're a completely different type from me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, Trainer?
choice_data_list: There's another hard worker over there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What caught my eye was a single Umamusume
running on the training track.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... What was the time...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—33.9 seconds.
I've finally... cleared the first hurdle...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That is... Flash-san.
Practicing her final spurt even at a time like this...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Good grief... What astonishing stamina. However...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we have—
our own way of playing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Let us surpass her. With a strategy that exceeds her earnest determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Our policy is unwavering. We will aim for the Classic Triple Crown through sheer strategic prowess.
